whoItsFor: Developers using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex) who want the agent to understand large codebases quickly and cheaply. It is also useful for anyone who wants a local, persistent code knowledge graph with no hosted service.
useCases: Index a repository so an agent can answer structural questions without repeated grep and file-read cycles
Trace call chains, impact analysis, and dead code detection across a codebase
Map cross-service HTTP routes and infrastructure-as-code (Dockerfiles, Kubernetes, compose) into one graph
